import inspect

import solution
from solution import min_Operations


def test_issue_example_2_4():
    """Example: min_Operations(2,4) == 1."""
    assert min_Operations(2, 4) == 1  # hand-computed: issue states expected is 1


def test_issue_equal_small_numbers_need_zero():
    """Already equal numbers need zero operations to make two numbers equal."""
    assert min_Operations(5, 5) == 0  # hand-computed: 5==5 already equal so 0 ops


def test_issue_equal_at_zero_boundary():
    """Already equal numbers need zero operations to make two numbers equal."""
    assert min_Operations(0, 0) == 0  # hand-computed: 0==0 already equal so 0 ops


def test_issue_equal_large_numbers_need_zero():
    """Already equal numbers need zero operations to make two numbers equal."""
    assert min_Operations(1000000, 1000000) == 0  # hand-computed: equal inputs so 0 ops


def test_issue_distinct_small_numbers_need_at_least_one():
    """Distinct numbers need at least one operation to make two numbers equal."""
    assert min_Operations(1, 2) >= 1  # hand-computed: 1!=2 so 0 ops insufficient, need >=1


def test_issue_distinct_with_zero_needs_at_least_one():
    """Distinct numbers need at least one operation to make two numbers equal."""
    assert min_Operations(0, 1) >= 1  # hand-computed: 0!=1 so 0 ops insufficient, need >=1


def test_issue_result_is_nonnegative():
    """Minimum operations required cannot be negative."""
    assert min_Operations(3, 7) >= 0  # hand-computed: operation count minimum is 0


def test_issue_result_is_integer_count():
    """Minimum operations required is an integer count."""
    assert isinstance(min_Operations(2, 4), int)


def test_contract_function_is_callable():
    """Public interface requires solution.min_Operations to exist and be callable."""
    assert callable(min_Operations)


def test_contract_signature_accepts_A_and_B():
    """Public interface requires min_Operations(A, B) to accept A and B."""
    params = list(inspect.signature(min_Operations).parameters.keys())
    assert params == ["A", "B"]  # hand-computed: interface lists exactly (A, B)


def test_contract_repeated_call_is_deterministic():
    """Public interface requires min_Operations(A, B) to behave as a pure function."""
    assert min_Operations(2, 4) == min_Operations(2, 4)  # hand-computed: same inputs give 1 == 1
